1. 13. 8

Padasuttāni (catuttha padasuttaṃ )

146. Seyyathāpi bhikkhave, yāni kānici jaṅgamānaṃ pāṇānaṃ padajātāni, sabbāni tāni hatthipade samodhānaṃ gacchati. Hatthipadaṃ tesaṃ aggamakkhāyati yadidaṃ mahantattena. Evameva kho bhikkhave, ye keci kusalā dhammā, sabbe te appamādamūlakā appamādasamosaraṇā appamādo tesaṃ dhammānaṃ aggamakkhāyati. Appamattassetaṃ bhikkhave, bhikkhuno pāṭikaṅkhaṃ "ariyaṃ aṭṭhaṅgikaṃ maggaṃ bhāvessati, ariyaṃ aṭṭhaṅgikaṃ maggaṃ bahulīkarissatī"ti. Kathañca bhikkhave, bhikkhu appamatto ariyaṃ aṭṭhaṅgikaṃ maggaṃ bhāveti, ariyaṃ aṭṭhaṅgikaṃ maggaṃ bahulīkarissatīti. Idha bhikkhave, bhikkhu sammādiṭṭhiṃ bhāveti nibbānaninnaṃ nibbānapoṇaṃ nibbānapabbhāraṃ, sammāsaṅkappaṃ bhāveti nibbānaninnaṃ nibbānapoṇaṃ nibbānapabbhāraṃ, sammāvācaṃ bhāveti nibbānaninnaṃ nibbānapoṇaṃ nibbānapabbhāraṃ, sammākammantaṃ bhāveti, nibbānaninnaṃ nibbānapoṇaṃ nibbānapabbhāraṃ, sammāājīvaṃ bhāveti nibbānaninnaṃ nibbānapoṇaṃ nibbānapabbhāraṃ, sammāvāyāmaṃ bhāveti nibbānaninnaṃ nibbānapoṇaṃ nibbānapabbhāraṃ, sammāsatiṃ bhāveti nibbānaninnaṃ nibbānapoṇaṃ nibbānapabbhāraṃ, sammāsamādhiṃ bhāveti nibbānaninnaṃ nibbānapoṇaṃ nibbānapabbhāraṃ. Evaṃ kho bhikkhave, bhikkhu appamatto ariyaṃ aṭṭhaṅgikaṃ maggaṃ bhāveti, ariyaṃ aṭṭhaṅgikaṃ maggaṃ bahulīkarotīti. 

(Yathā tathāgatasuttāni tathā vitthāretabbāni)
